I usually listen to music if I can't fall asleep easily because it's helpful for falling asleep.
sentences.ko: 저는 쉽게 잠들지 못할 때 보통 음악을 들어요. 왜냐하면 잠드는 데 도움이 되기 때문이에요.
sentences.question: Q1) What do you usually do if you can't fall asleep easily? Why do you do that?
extra: It's very helpful for falling asleep.

sentences.en: Yes, I think using my phone before bed affects my sleep because it's very distracting.
sentences.ko: 네, 저는 잠들기 전에 휴대폰을 사용하는 것이 제 수면에 영향을 준다고 생각해요, 왜냐하면 그것이 집중을 매우 방해하기 때문이에요.
sentences.question: Q2) Do you think using your phone before bed affects your sleep? Why or why not?
extra: It is very distracting for students, so students can't focus on their studies.

sentences.en: No, I wouldn't say I get enough sleep on a regular basis. First, I'm a student, so I'm busy with my schoolwork. I don't have much time to get sleep. Also, I don't get enough sleep these days because I'm stressed out. So, I couldn't say I get enough sleep on a regular basis.
sentences.ko: 아니요, 저는 평소에 충분한 수면을 취한다고 말할 수 없어요. 첫째, 저는 학생이어서 학업에 바뻐요. 저는 충분히 잠잘 시간이 별로 없어요. 또한, 저는 스트레스를 많이 받아서 요즘 충분히 잠을 자지 못하고 있어요. 그래서 저는 평소에 충분히 잠을 자는 편은 아니에요.
sentences.question: Q3) Would you say you get enough sleep on a regular basis? Why or why not?

sentences.en: If I buy a new smartphone, I think a camera is the most important factor. First, it's very convenient and useful if my smartphone has a good camera.
